champion: Pseudoaneurysm of the inferior mesenteric artery
ordered_diagnoses: Pseudoaneurysm of the inferior mesenteric artery

s1.syndrome_frame: Acute abdominal pain with increasing severity and evidence of intra-abdominal hemorrhage
salient_findings: Paroxysmal abdominal pain increasing in severity
Tenderness in the left lower quadrant of the abdomen
Massive fluid collection in the abdomen on ultrasonography
Pseudoaneurysm formation in the left branch of the inferior mesenteric artery on CT and DSA
key_facts: Pain intensity increased in the left lower abdomen 7 hours after admission
No history of fever, weight loss, pancreatitis, surgery, hematochezia, vascular diseases, or previous angiography
Abdominal ultrasonography showed massive fluid collection
CT showed nodular contrast medium staining, extravasation, intra-abdominal hemorrhage, pseudoaneurysm formation, and multiple hematoceles
DSA confirmed pseudoaneurysm formation, 4 mm in diameter, arising from the left branch of the inferior mesenteric artery

s4.champion: Pseudoaneurysm of the inferior mesenteric artery

raw.champion: Pseudoaneurysm of the inferior mesenteric artery
raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of paroxysmal abdominal pain, low hemoglobin, and imaging findings of nodular contrast medium staining, extravasation, intra-abdominal hemorrhage, and pseudoaneurysm formation in the left branch of the inferior mesenteric artery, as confirmed by DSA, strongly support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Inferior mesenteric artery aneurysm
rejected.why: While aneurysm is a related condition, the specific finding of pseudoaneurysm, which is a leakage of arterial blood from an artery into the surrounding tissue with a persistent communication between the originating artery and the resultant adjacent cavity, is more precise

rejected.label: Intra-abdominal hemorrhage due to trauma
rejected.why: There is no history of trauma provided in the case

rejected.label: Ruptured abdominal aortic aneurysm
rejected.why: The imaging studies specifically identify the pseudoaneurysm in the left branch of the inferior mesenteric artery, not the abdominal aorta

rejected.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
rejected.why: This condition is a type of vasculitis that affects medium-sized arteries, but the case presentation and imaging findings do not provide evidence of widespread arterial involvement characteristic of polyarteritis nodosa
